title: Marketing intake origin key (private repo AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web)
description: Part of story chatticus-a170754a (Secrets and generated keys live in SSM Parameter Store SecureString, created by infrastructure code); read its description for the full plan, order and hazards. IntakeOriginKey lives in the private website repo, stack ChatticusMarketing, infra/lib/marketing-stack.ts (generateSecretString 48 characters). It is resolved at deploy into the intake Lambda environment and the CloudFront origin header x-intake-origin-key through unsafeUnwrap; ssm-secure is unsupported for both, so it stays in Secrets Manager. Work in that repo, not this one; only record the decision there. Keep the public/private boundary (chatticus-3926bc).
